text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the day off, Trainer.<n>Rest assured, I
put it to good use.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've finally cleared away all of those<n>errands I had
piling up!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't mean I didn't allow<n>myself to recover,
of course.<n>Physically, it was a welcome reprieve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And as for mentally... There's no<n>better way to
unwind than spending a<n>break doing what you
enjoy,<n>wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Symboli Rudolf spent<n>her day off
doing what she does best.
